# fmc_cipher_suite_lists (Data Source)

This data source reads the Cipher Suite Lists.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_cipher_suite_lists" "example" {
  items = {
    "my_cipher_suite_lists" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of Cipher Suite Lists. The key of the map is the name of the individual Cipher Suite List. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cipher_suites` (Attributes Set) Set of predefined cipher suites which are part of the cipher suite list object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--cipher_suites))
- `id` (String) Id of the Cipher Suite List object.
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'CipherSuiteList'.

<a id="nestedatt--items--cipher_suites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.cipher_suites`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the cipher suite.
